description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.13): one of the Troll Matriarch's three brood nests in the Troll Den - wet branches, hides and bones that no blow can break: only fire burns it (BroodNest refuses every hit without fire). Fire comes from the brazier beside it (smashed, its coals spill into the nest) or from a whelp or troll thrown into the den's fire pit and then at the nest. Burning one pays 50 XP; when all three have burned, world.troll_den.nests_burned is set (the woodfolk then pull down the den's back wall: the drive-out resolution of the woodfolk's oath).
locked_message: Blows only scatter the nest's wet branches. Burn it: smash the brazier beside it, or throw a burning troll at it.
